RNPLens offline viewer: real-screen check

Viewer status: automatically tested, awaiting manual visual confirmation; not fully visually qualified.

Six offline pages written by rnplens view (RNPLens 0.4 development candidate, commit 2677969). Open each page from this folder with networking off. The steps and the result form are in OWNER_SCREEN_CHECK.md; the expected highlighted residues of every structure are in expected_highlights.json.

page	structures	RNA region
1_1VTM_RNA_1-3	10	1-3
1b_2JEA_RNA_26-35	10	26-35
3_6BJG_representatives_t0.3	2	all contacts
3_6BJG_representatives_t0.5	5	all contacts
3_6BJG_representatives_t0.7	18	all contacts
3_6BJG_all_50	50	all contacts

Highlighted residues are Report's per-structure contacts; a highlighted contact is a feature of the prediction, not an observation of the real complex, and nothing here measures correctness.
